headword: {温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}

definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese inn that features natural hot spring baths, typically offering Japanese-style rooms, meals, and hospitality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a hot spring inn on the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}→露天風呂：14611_rotenburo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This hot spring inn is famous for its open-air bath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We went to a hot spring inn as a family and enjoyed delicious food and hot springs.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot spring) + ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ (traditional Japanese inn). One of the most iconic types of Japanese accommodation, combining the relaxation of natural hot spring bathing with traditional hospitality.

TYPICAL FEATURES:
- ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧: Japanese-style tatami rooms
- ⟦{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}→露天風呂：14611_rotenburo⟧: open-air baths
- {内湯|うちゆ}: indoor baths
- {懐石料理|かいせきりょうり} or ⟦{会席料理|かいせきりょうり}→会席料理：26980_kaisekiryouri⟧: multi-course Japanese meals
- ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧: yukata provided for guests
- ⟦{仲居|なかい}→仲居：11719_nakai⟧: room attendants

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧: to stay at a hot spring inn
- {温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to book a hot spring inn
- ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}: a long-established hot spring inn

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧: traditional Japanese inn — not necessarily with hot springs
- ⟦{民宿|みんしゅく}→民宿：08165_minshuku⟧: family-run guesthouse — simpler, more affordable
- {湯治場|とうじば}: hot spring cure resort — focused on therapeutic bathing
